sources.title: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we explore if a lightweight multimodal model can accurately estimate the reasoning performance of a much larger LLM across variable reasoning budgets. To study this, we introduce Bud-getDoc, the first multimodal benchmark providing explicit supervision for model-budget-performance trade-offs across three document-centric tasks.

sources.title: Lightweight multimodal large language model enabling ... - Springer
sources.snippet: However, most deep learning approaches rely on extensive defect datasets, making them unsuitable for real-world scenarios where only a single defective instance may be available. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Light-MLLMAD, a Lightweight Multimodal Large Language Model framework designed for one-shot industrial anomaly detection.

sources.snippet: A novel lightweight multimodal architecture optimized for one-shot industrial anomaly detection. An interpretable prompt-grounded reasoning mechanism integrating linguistic and visual representations. A computationally efficient framework suitable for real-time industrial edge deployment.
